Hi Monica and Vivek,

I wanted to raise a confidential personnel action for Diego Fernandez (eng, Platform). After the recent org adjustments and Diego's expressed development goals, I am proposing we move Laura Bennett into the manager role for Diego effective 2026-09-01, starting with a 4-week shadow/mentorship period. This is a sensitive change — Diego has been high-performing but has some coaching areas we discussed in calibration.

Key items attached: performance_summary_2026.pdf (trimmed summary for HR), a draft manager_shadow_agreement.docx, and an outline mentorship_timeline.xlsx.

As background: Diego has indicated openness to a manager change for growth and career track clarity. Laura has been acting lead on two sprints and has completed the manager fundamentals course; she’s volunteered to do a gradual takeover with Priya as backup for critical escalations.

As this is a confidential nomination rather than a public announcement, can HR confirm the following next steps?
- Quick legal/comp check for any compensation impact (I flagged one mid-cycle bonus eligibility question)
- Approval to set formal manager-of-record on 9/1 (paperwork + DocuSign)
- Guidance on how we notify Diego and the team (timing & wording)

I’ve kept this off calendar/public channels until we have approvals.

Thanks,
Priya
Director, Engineering (Platform)
Redwood Inference

Week 1–4 (Sep 7 - Oct 4): manager-of-record with Priya as escalation backup; weekly 30-minute mentoring sessions and explicit goals for cross-team collaboration.
30/60/90: check-ins with Priya & Vivek to confirm impact on team deliverables and career progression.
